summary: Russia, Canada and the Nordics come at once, Mongolia and Estonia take a thought, and Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan are the fair surprise. Greenland and Antarctica are free; Denmark, Switzerland and Latvia are the near misses.
reasons: Casual found 8 (Mongolia and Estonia were the swing; without them it is 6), losing 4 lives on Denmark #25, Switzerland #11, Kazakhstan #14 and Latvia #12, each shown with its temperature. By par that is a crowd average near 6 (5 if they miss both). Fan found 10/10, losing 1.

The prompt says sovereign countries and the measure, so the obvious wrong answers are free: Greenland, Svalbard, Antarctica, Alaska, Siberia. The figures match the World Bank 1991-2020 table on the page, and all ten facts check out against their sources.

No other climate list in the bank. It is a countries list with a twist, which the owner likes, and it suits a December day. Keep it away from other Nordic-heavy lists (happiest-countries, winter-olympics-countries).
fixes: Junk redirect aliases from the shared country set (already queued as "Country lists: UK aliases and redirect junk"): Mongolia "Mongolian cyclone", "Mongolia national amateur boxing athletes", "Western Mongolia" (a region), "Mohron ync"; Kyrgyzstan "Aiyl okmotu", "Ayıl ökmötü", "Ayil ökmötü", "Okmotu" and "Aiyl" (its village councils: "aiyl" alone now gives Kyrgyzstan); Tajikistan "North Persia".
